summary: Edit (preset): edits the mod's name, products or selector presets (preset.edit); a removed preset goes to the trash, restorable for 30 days.
name: preset.edit

input.description: One of the variants: add, copy, remove, restore, rename, move.

capability.when: A mod is focused and the preset or product named exists.

refusals.reason: That preset or product no longer exists.

effect.commit: Edits the mod's name, products or selector presets (preset.edit); a removed preset goes to the trash, restorable for 30 days.
